value.rationale: The integral basis generated by a single small symmetry orbit is a motivated geometric refinement of an existing four-sphere-wedge result for a canonical Archimedean graph. The 56 minimal twelve-vertex crosspolytope supports and their 8/12/12/24 orbit distribution identify the shortest natural geometric representatives; other individual orbits span only primitive rank-three sublattices. The rational character and integral central inversion sign expose equivariant structure not implied by the Betti number or uniform vertex-deletion splitting. Exact stand-alone certificates make the finite result independently reproducible.
